scenes.text: Your helper is already strong and your computers are still scattered so home and work never line up
This does not replace your mind and any helper can load one tool and reach every computer you own
Your helper only talks to the cloud hub and each computer reaches out by itself so the job runs on the one you pick and comes back
When the official channel dies the context dies with it and we bind to the hub so your fleet is still there
You need the website one token a program on each computer and the tool in your helper so put the server in the cloud
Open the website on screen and use one tool for all your computers
